run fsck.krffs on the copy

the kernel never says halting instead

the kernel never says reboot: restarting
fsck.krffs exits 0 and does not call the copy not cleanly unmounted
the second boot reads back the marker written just before the power-off

progress.means: a step of the manifest has ended
fsck.krffs has ended

native.reason: poweroff ends the machine, and the readback needs a boot of the disk the stop left
